hero.heading: Healthcare that meets you where you are
hero.subheading: Acute Insight AI was built on a simple belief: the first minutes of a medical visit shouldn't be spent re-collecting what a patient could have told you already. We pair patients' own words with AI-powered intake so every visit starts informed.

body.text: The average in-person visit starts with a clipboard, a repeated medication list, and questions the patient has answered a dozen times before. Most of that effort never makes it into a form the clinician can actually use.

Acute Insight AI closes that gap. Patients complete an adaptive, conversational intake from any device — and their provider receives a structured clinical brief with flagged considerations before the visit begins.
By letting AI handle the data collection, clinicians spend their time on what matters: listening, examining, and treating.

howItWorks.heading: From first symptom to an informed visit

steps.title: Complete your AI intake
steps.body: A natural conversation with Ace, our AI assistant, captures your story in minutes — by voice or text: what's going on, how severe, your medications, allergies, and history. No generic forms.

steps.title: AI structures your story
steps.body: Your responses are organized into a concise clinical brief. Red-flag symptoms, high severity, and chronic patterns are surfaced as flags so nothing important gets buried.

steps.title: Your provider walks in prepared
steps.body: Your clinician reviews the brief before your visit — so the appointment starts at the real conversation, not the clipboard.

ai.heading: AI that thinks like a clinician

body.text: Our intake runs on a frontier large language model, guided by a physician-written clinical protocol: it asks one question at a time, follows the thread of your complaint the way an experienced triage nurse would, and never diagnoses or prescribes.

When you describe chest pain, it asks about what matters for chest pain. When you report a headache, it screens for red-flag features. A deterministic safety layer runs alongside the AI on every single message — emergency symptoms trigger an immediate 911 prompt, no model judgment required.
Critically, the system knows its limits. It gathers and organizes your history for your clinician — the diagnosis and the plan stay where they belong, with a human who knows you.

hipaa.heading: Your data, handled like it matters
hipaa.body: Acute Insight AI was founded by a physician who works with protected health information every day. Patient data is encrypted in transit, access is role-based (your intake is visible only to you and your care team), and we never sell, share, or advertise with health information. Before general availability, our launch checklist includes the full set of HIPAA safeguards: encryption at rest, audit logging, and business associate agreements across our infrastructure.
